name: PT Jaya Konstruksi Manggala Pratama Tbk
summary: PT Jaya Konstruksi Manggala Pratama Tbk engages in the construction business in Indonesia. The company is involved in pertamina asphalt and liquefied petroleum gas trading; station LPG and bulk transportation; chartering of vessels; supply of electricity, gas, and steam; transportation, warehousing, professional, scientific, and engineering activities; construction and trading, building services, and industry activities; provision of contractor and services; and general trading, manufacturing, and workshop and industry activities.
